record.official_identifier: Assembly Bill 406 (83rd Session, 2025); Statutes of Nevada 2025, Chapter 283
record.notes: Passed the Assembly 42-0 on 22 Apr 2025 and, as amended, the Senate 20-1 on 21 May 2025; approved by the Governor on 5 Jun 2025 and filed as chapter 283 on 6 Jun 2025. Effective 1 Jul 2025; the law amends NRS chapters 391, 433 and 629. Sponsored by Assemblymembers Jovan Jackson and Hanadi Nadeem. One of the first state laws, with Illinois HB 1806, to bar AI from delivering therapy.
